identity: complete: boolean; missing-event or dropped-event count must be zero
actual controller/adapter/sidecar/model commits and exact build/assembly hashes
actual native/managed dependency hashes, native version and input capability; no relabeling older capture
clock: exact clock value used by adapter: IEEE754 binary64 bits, including rejected nonfinite values
sample elapsed and simulation time remain separate optional diagnostic clocks
native-call and physical-effect timing availability declared separately
settings: immutable setting snapshot SHA256 and revision referenced by every process/reset event
full ForceOptions used to create structural preview
cadence selected build/constructor identity and enabled flag
exact binary32 peakPercent/peakLimit and slewPerSecond; headroom zero; no collision/event reserve
cap-change creation and zero-priming explicitly ordered; never infer from model reset epoch

everyEvent: strictly increasing observationSequence; source row sequence nullable for out-of-band events
settings revision; model epoch and separate cadence epoch
process: exact output clock binary64 bits actually passed to adapter
modelValid/modelReason and unambiguous semantic gate tag/version
computed command binary32 bits before submission and conditioner rejection reason
stateTransition: explicit begin/terminal-stop/prepare/reacquire/panic/shutdown, gate suppression, reset and cap-change events
ordered model reset and cadence reset epochs before/after plus reason
nonfinite/duplicate/rewound/stale clock rejection followed by caller zero/reset actions
gated row must not invent a clock read or adapter invocation that did not occur
outputCall: attempted command binary32 bits distinct from accepted Sent; unavailable is not zero
ordered Write | ZeroAndStop | Panic | Close including initialization/reacquire/out-of-band calls
result: returned-true | returned-false | not-applicable | exception; associated error if observed
managed submission boundary clock if observed; never substitute sample timestamp
exact nominal integer if actually observed at native boundary, otherwise unavailable

replayAndAuditRules: Missing required identity/clock/settings/reset/gate/call fields or partial events makes command replay unavailable
Reuse exact production adapter/shared arithmetic in a separate pure fake-device replay fixture; do not copy formulas
Supply recorded clock bits in original order, including invalid clock values; invoke original resets/settings transitions
Compare computed command, attempted command, acceptance result and accepted Sent as distinct values
No physical device/native hardware playback; native watchdog/driver interventions remain unobserved unless independently recorded
No command cadence/nominal value proves native effect timing, delivered torque or cross-game feel equivalence
Retain original datasets; new observations use versioned exclusive CreateNew output and separate hashes
Do not promote captureKind from injected scenario to observed runtime when using recorded elapsed timestamps
requiredFutureConformanceCases: cap change zero prime without pretending model reset
duplicate/rewound/stale/nonfinite adapter clocks with explicit guarded zero
valid model plus conditioning-invalid gate distinct from model-invalid
failed write retains attempted nonzero command and zero accepted Sent
prepare/reacquire zero, panic, terminal stop and zero-before-close outside car sampling
missing clock/reset/call event, dropped event and identity mismatch unavailable
atomic output ownership and immutable original source/reference identity
